verdict.rationale: Resend documents an official CLI: llms.txt points to docs for installing and using the Resend CLI, and a probe found an official resend/resend-cli repository. Multiple docs and changelog entries name the CLI as a supported surface alongside the API, SDKs and MCP server, including domain verification, segment renaming and headless webhooks. missing for 10: an in-depth CLI command reference or installation guide in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, and explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output).
